newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Jospin, Britain's Blair to meet next week.
newsitem.headline: France's Jospin, Britain's Blair to meet next week.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair will get together informally next week with his French counterpart Lionel Jospin during Blair's holiday stay in southwestern France, a Jospin aide said on Tuesday.
"They will meet informally, they are going to see one another," the Jospin aide told Reuters. He added that no date or place had yet been set for the meeting.
Blair is to arrive in southwestern France on Sunday for a holiday visit of a few days.
The British premier, his wife Cherie and their children Nicholas, Kathryn and Euan will be staying in the home of David Keene, a London lawyer, located in the village of Saint Martin d'Oydes.
The village is located some 30 km (20 miles) from Cintegabelle, the main city in the parliamentary district represented by Jospin, France's Socialist prime minister.
